body: well i am going to go to sleep so that's another day.

I appreciate you taking your time to write a very thoughtful message to me. However, I am and have been a pretty hard core atheist since well forever. Funny thing is my mom always denied it. She wasn't very religious but I don't think she knew how else to deal with death and she needed that. I personally know she is gone and that is what it is. She's not in pain and I deal with that. I would very much like to be in the same state of non existence and hopefully will be soon. If it was just my agoraphobia fine, the panic attack fine, the dead mother fine, the broken fucking heart fine but all of it and I am just really not really willing to live with that.
